The pooled best-fit MNI-to-Talairach (MTT) transform of Lancaster et al. 2007 (Human Brain Mapping 28:1194-1205,
doi 10.1002/hbm.20345), Eq. (3), "MTT pooled", read from the equation image of the open-access full text
(retrieved 2026-11-17), and the same four rows as BrainMap's icbm_other2tal.m applies them (the variable
icbm_other, retrieved 2026-11-17). tal2icbm_other.m inverts these rows to go from Talairach to MNI.
The two copies, and the copy in NiMARE's nimare.utils.tal2mni, agree digit for digit.

Eq. (3), MTT pooled (row-major, 4 x 4):
  0.9357   0.0029  -0.0072  -1.0423
 -0.0065   0.9396  -0.0726  -1.3940
  0.0103   0.0752   0.8967   3.6475
  0        0        0        1

icbm_other2tal.m, icbm_other:
icbm_other = [0.9357 0.0029 -0.0072 -1.0423
			 -0.0065 0.9396 -0.0726 -1.3940
			  0.0103 0.0752  0.8967  3.6475
			  0.0000 0.0000  0.0000  1.0000];

From the paper's text (Results, "MTT Transform Analysis" and Table IV): the mean coordinate of the
anterior commissure (AC) in MNI space fitted with FSL is (0.3, 1.4, -4.4) mm; "Best-fit MTT transforms led
to coordinate disparity at the AC and PC of ~1 mm for both SPM2 and FLS (Table V)".

Table V of the paper (distance in mm between mean MNI and Talairach coordinates for select landmark
sites, N = 10 brains; the "MTT" columns are MNI coordinates transformed using the best-fit MTT
transforms of each package, the paper's Eqs. (1) for SPM2 and (2) for FSL; the pooled Eq. (3) is not
in this table). Values only, the standard errors are dropped:
Landmark | SPM2 MNI | SPM2 mni2tal | SPM2 MTT | FSL MNI | FSL mni2tal | FSL MTT
Anterior | 13.6 | 16.2 | 1.3 | 8.9 | 11.7 | 0.5
Superior | 13.0 | 14.3 | 2.7 | 9.2 | 10.3 | 1.4
Inferior | 10.3 | 6.8 | 2.3 | 7.0 | 4.7 | 1.8
Posterior | 10.2 | 13.7 | 2.6 | 6.9 | 10.7 | 2.1
Right | 5.6 | 5.1 | 1.6 | 4.6 | 4.6 | 1.5
Left | 4.9 | 5.4 | 1.8 | 2.7 | 3.0 | 1.2
AC | 4.6 | 3.6 | 1.0 | 3.0 | 2.4 | 1.0
PC | 0.6 | 1.4 | 1.4 | 1.0 | 1.9 | 1.4
